description: Find dishes across all venues by text, city, dietary tags or allergens to avoid. Each item is tagged with its venue, so one call compares venues; for one named venue use venue_menu.

allergens.description: Exclude items that declare any of these allergens (spelling-insensitive; synonyms match: milk, lactose and dairy all match dairy; pass one term).

city.description: Only return items from venues in this city (case-insensitive); call list_cities for the exact values.

cursor.description: Number of items to skip; pass `next_cursor` from the previous page.

dietary_tags.description: Require ALL of these dietary tags (case- and separator-insensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

max_price.description: Only items priced at or under this, in the menu's currency.

query.description: Text matched in item name, description, section and menu names; every word must match; connector words (and, with, in) aren't required.

name: search_menus

outputSchema.description: The Yenta response envelope: a status, the answer in `item` or `items`, and the approved content revision it was read from.

title: Search menus across venues
